statement: Secondary-market listings for NVIDIA H100 80GB cards appear at $27,999.99 pre-owned PCIe, $27,000.00 brand new, $21,400 to $22,490 for SXM5-converted-to-PCIe units, and $20,877 for pre-owned HBM3 units.
why: Resale asking prices show what buyers are willing to pay to bypass vendor lead times, but a snapshot without a stated baseline is only a level.

impact.mechanism: Secondary-market asking prices for prior-generation accelerators reflect residual scarcity value; with no baseline or stated change this is a static level.

evidence.source: eBay search results (via web search snippets)
evidence.excerpt: Pre-owned H100 80GB PCIe cards listed at "$27,999.99"; brand new H100 80GB cards priced at "$27,000.00"; SXM5 converted to PCIe models ranging "$21,400.00 to $22,490.00"; pre-owned H100 80GB HBM3 units listed at "$20,877.00"

confidence.basis: Listing prices gathered from search snippets because the eBay pages timed out; asking prices are not transactions.

dispersion: Listed prices span roughly $20,877 to $27,999.99 across condition and form factor, with pre-owned PCIe above brand-new asking.
